schema_note: One window only, the plan's own. trip-windows/1 (overview spec 2.2) needs 2 to 4 windows, so this file keeps the same field names under trip-season-basic/1 and adds a `season` block in the adapter's Season shape.
months_basis_note: The plan's own month: one day late in August.

points.name: Welland climate station
points.note: Station coordinates as printed on the ECCC normals page (42 59'33" N, 79 15'40" W). It is the nearest 1991-2020 normals location to the Niagara River found; it is inland, south-west of the gorge.

why.value: The plan's own day out; normals give warm afternoons and a long evening for a sunset at the river mouth.

tempC.value: 15 to 26 C (mean daily low to high in August)

rain.value: About 9 days with 1 mm or more in August; about 79 mm in the month

daylight.value: Sunrise about 06:35, sunset about 20:00; about 13 hours 20 minutes of day
daylight.note: core/bin/sun.ts at the station point for the plan day: sunrise 06:37, sunset 20:00, civil dusk 20:29, day 13h22m.

notes.text: Civil twilight lasts about half an hour after sunset

windows.label: One day late in August
windows.verdict_note: Not set: only the plan's own window was researched, so there is nothing to rank it against.
windows.best_for: A long summer day along the river ending with a sunset

plus.text: Sunset near 20:00 leaves a full day of light

minus.text: Rain on about one day in three in August

unknown.text: Normals for the Niagara River corridor itself
unknown.tried: ECCC 1991-2020 normals station list for Ontario: no St. Catharines or Niagara Falls location; Welland and Vineland are the nearest. Welland used.

unknown.text: Crowd level on a late-summer weekend
